proof_body:
by
  intro u₁ u₂ u₃ v₁ v₂ v₃ x₀ y₀ z₀ x y z hN
  constructor
  · intro h
    set n₁ := u₂ * v₃ - u₃ * v₂ with hn₁
    set n₂ := u₃ * v₁ - u₁ * v₃ with hn₂
    set n₃ := u₁ * v₂ - u₂ * v₁ with hn₃
    set w₁ := x - x₀ with hw₁
    set w₂ := y - y₀ with hw₂
    set w₃ := z - z₀ with hw₃
    set N := n₁ ^ 2 + n₂ ^ 2 + n₃ ^ 2 with hNdef
    set A := (w₂ * v₃ - w₃ * v₂) * n₁ + (w₃ * v₁ - w₁ * v₃) * n₂ + (w₁ * v₂ - w₂ * v₁) * n₃ with hA
    set B := (u₂ * w₃ - u₃ * w₂) * n₁ + (u₃ * w₁ - u₁ * w₃) * n₂ + (u₁ * w₂ - u₂ * w₁) * n₃ with hB
    have e1 : N * w₁ = A * u₁ + B * v₁ := by
      simp only [hNdef, hA, hB, hn₁, hn₂, hn₃] at *
      linear_combination (u₂ * v₃ - u₃ * v₂) * h
    have e2 : N * w₂ = A * u₂ + B * v₂ := by
      simp only [hNdef, hA, hB, hn₁, hn₂, hn₃] at *
      linear_combination (u₃ * v₁ - u₁ * v₃) * h
    have e3 : N * w₃ = A * u₃ + B * v₃ := by
      simp only [hNdef, hA, hB, hn₁, hn₂, hn₃] at *
      linear_combination (u₁ * v₂ - u₂ * v₁) * h
    refine ⟨A / N, B / N, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have : x - x₀ = (A / N) * u₁ + (B / N) * v₁ := by
        rw [← hw₁]; field_simp; linarith
      linarith
    · have : y - y₀ = (A / N) * u₂ + (B / N) * v₂ := by
        rw [← hw₂]; field_simp; linarith
      linarith
    · have : z - z₀ = (A / N) * u₃ + (B / N) * v₃ := by
        rw [← hw₃]; field_simp; linarith
      linarith
  · rintro ⟨s, t, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    ring
target_source: ∀ (u₁ u₂ u₃ v₁ v₂ v₃ x₀ y₀ z₀ x y z : ℝ), (u₂ * v₃ - u₃ * v₂) ^ 2 + (u₃ * v₁ - u₁ * v₃) ^ 2 + (u₁ * v₂ - u₂ * v₁) ^ 2 ≠ 0 → ((u₂ * v₃ - u₃ * v₂) * (x - x₀) + (u₃ * v₁ - u₁ * v₃) * (y - y₀) + (u₁ * v₂ - u₂ * v₁) * (z - z₀) = 0 ↔ ∃ s t : ℝ, x = x₀ + s * u₁ + t * v₁ ∧ y = y₀ + s * u₂ + t * v₂ ∧ z = z₀ + s * u₃ + t * v₃)
